connected_pair.resources: empty connected fluid buffers; active Vat output to passive Mixer input

fluidizer.parts: controller, solid injector, output port, power port, ordinary casing

reprocessor.parts: controller, top waste injector, side fluid injector/output/power, bottom collector, ordinary casing

reactor.parts: controller, top control rod, interior fuel rod, ordinary casing

scenarios.initial_assembly: preloaded chunks; placement through stable ordinary ZeroCore assembly
scenarios.structural_disassembly: remove a casing corner through observed unassembled controllers
scenarios.structural_reassembly: replace original corner state through stable assembly
scenarios.warm_chunk_unload: remove force ticket through unload event, absent full chunk and removed old controller entity
scenarios.warm_chunk_reload: force/load chunk through valid stable assembly and derived state readiness
scenarios.cold_restore: copy known saved world/config for each fresh-process repetition; acquire saved chunks after server started through stable assembly
scenarios.idle: ordinary server ticks while assembled/inactive, empty input/storage, no pending structural queues
scenarios.activation_deactivation: ordinary synchronous public activation/deactivation callbacks without productive intervening ticks
scenarios.shutdown_to_server_stopped: halt through server save/unload completion event
scenarios.jvm_start_to_server_started: JVM uptime through server-start event and benchmark initialization; broader than world load
scenarios.server_stopped_to_gradle_exit: external process completion interval, includes JFR export and Gradle overhead
